By the authority vested in me as President and as Commander in Chief of the 
Armed Eorces of the United States of America, with recognition of the crucial 
importance to national security of the Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program, and 
for the purpose of preserving the basic structure, policies, and practices 
developed for this Program in the past and assuring that the Program will 
continue to function with excellence, it is hereby ordered as follows:
Section 1. The Naval Nuclear Propulsion Program is an integrated program 
carried out by two organizational units, one in the Department of Energy and 
the other in the Department of the Navy.
